vendors.about:
Since 2006, I have a demonstrated track record of successfully growing both revenue and profits while working at elite companies in both the gaming and technology industries.  

With a background and comprehensive understanding of conducting business in Native America, network technology, the gaming and hospitality industries, software applications, data utilization, and player experience, I am passionate about partnering with Tribes and casino industry professionals, helping bring proven technologies from outside industries to help improve Tribal reservation life, as well as casino and hospitality technology improvements for the businesses.

I pride myself on hard work, team work, building strong customer relationships, and being kind to my colleagues.

Yo hablo español.
vendors.name: Coghlan Tech Group

projects.description: Builds the franchise system that is the structural foundation of FLI Golf. 12 franchise slots have been created — Hyzer Heroes, Huk-a-Mania, Flight Squad, Birdie Storm, Chain Breakers, Disc Jesters, Midas Touch, Chain Seekers, Fairway Bombers, Disc Dynasty, Ace Makers, and Glide Masters — each representing a $10M ownership opportunity. Current priorities: assigning territories to each franchise, opening the franchise sales pipeline to qualified buyers, and preparing the legal framework for ownership transfers — franchise agreements, territory licensing, operating standards, and owner onboarding documentation. Owns the official rulebook, officiating standards, and competitive format that define how FLI Golf is played. Manages player contracts and roster assignments across both MPO and FPO divisions. Coordinates with Legal Services on franchise agreement drafting and with the Sponsor Outreach team on the 3 active sponsors (MGM Grand, Hard Rock, Pechanga) who have flagged franchise ownership interest — each representing a potential conversion from sponsorship to a $10M franchise purchase. Budget covers legal drafting, owner onboarding materials, travel for franchise sales meetings, and league office staffing through launch.
projects.name: Franchise Dev & Legal

projects.description: Drives the sponsorship revenue that funds the league launch. Currently managing a pipeline of 8 casino and gaming partners across 4 tiers — 6 have signed Letters of Intent totaling $20M in annual commitments, with Wynn Resorts ($7M) actively negotiating and Mohegan Sun in early prospect stage. Tier 1 (Naming Rights, $7M/yr): MGM Grand Casino (Las Vegas, LOI signed) and Wynn Resorts (Las Vegas, negotiating). Tier 2 (League Partners, $5M/yr): Caesars Palace and Hard Rock Hotel & Casino. Tier 3 (Event Vendors, $1M/yr): Atlantis Casino Resort, Seminole Gaming, and Pechanga Resort Casino. Tier 4 (Growth): Mohegan Sun (prospect). Responsibilities include building and delivering sponsor decks, negotiating contract terms, coordinating with Legal on sponsorship agreements, managing partner relationships through activation, and identifying new prospects in gaming, sports betting, fantasy, and consumer brand categories to fill remaining tier slots before launch.

projects.description: Produces the flagship content that introduces FLI Golf to the world before the first tournament is played. Two primary deliverables: a full-length documentary following the founding of the league — the vision, the players, the franchise owners, and the road to launch — and a high-energy sizzle reel used in investor presentations, sponsor decks, and broadcast partner pitches. Filming began June 2026 and runs through the first season, with final delivery targeted for early 2028. Go Throw Media is the primary production partner, providing on-site crews at key milestones — franchise signings, player announcements, sponsor activations, and tournament events. The sizzle reel is a living asset updated as new footage comes in — each major milestone generates a new cut used immediately in outreach. Content produced here feeds directly into the Sponsor Outreach team's pitch materials, the Active Income pipeline for broadcast rights negotiations, and the league's social and streaming channels. Budget of $505,000 covers production crew, equipment, travel to filming locations, post-production, music licensing, and final delivery in broadcast-ready formats.
projects.name: Documentary & Sizzle Reel

projects.description: Manages the ongoing media partnership with Go Throw — FLI Golf's primary professional event coverage partner. Go Throw provides on-site videography, photography, and post-production for tournaments and league activations. Deliverables include highlight reels, player feature content, social media assets, and broadcast-quality footage used across FLI Golf's streaming, sponsorship decks, and fan channels. The partnership is structured as quarterly payments totaling $80,000 annually. This project tracks payment scheduling, deliverable milestones, and content handoff timelines. Works closely with the Documentary & Sizzle Reel project for behind-the-scenes footage and the Content & Media department for distribution and publishing. Go Throw coverage is a key asset for sponsor activation — footage is used in sponsor recap reports and renewal presentations to demonstrate event reach and production quality.
projects.name: Go Throw Media Partnership

projects.description: USPTO trademark filings for all FLI Golf marks — league wordmarks, franchise logos, and class registrations. Active now to protect IP before the league launches.

departments.description: Responsible for the full physical and digital infrastructure of every FLI Golf event. Covers venue scouting, stadium-format course design, and obstacle fabrication for each of the 6 annual tournaments. Owns the live streaming stack — broadcast production crew, camera systems, graphics, and replay technology. Builds and maintains the real-time scoring platform that feeds data to betting integrations, fantasy platforms, and the fan-facing mobile app. Also responsible for the FGL website, fan experience technology at events, and all hardware deployed on-course.
departments.name: Event Production & Technology

departments.description: The operational backbone of the league. Manages contracts, travel logistics, and competition scheduling for 20+ committed professional players across both MPO and FPO divisions. Leads the franchise development process — owner onboarding, territory assignments, and the legal framework governing team ownership. Staffs the league office: commissioner, operations director, legal counsel, and compliance. Owns the official rulebook, officiating standards, and the competitive format that defines how FLI Golf is played and judged.
departments.name: League Operations & Team Development

departments.description: Builds the media assets that tell the FLI Golf story beyond the tournament. Produces the full-length documentary and behind-the-scenes content for streaming platforms. Manages trading card production, gaming asset licensing, and collectibles partnerships. Runs the social media content team responsible for athlete storytelling, short-form video, and community engagement. Packages broadcast rights for domestic and international distribution and coordinates with streaming partners on content delivery.
departments.name: Media & Content Buildout

departments.description: Funds the go-to-market push and protects the league's financial runway. Executes the launch campaign targeting disc golf fans, sports bettors, and fantasy sports audiences across digital and traditional channels. Leads sponsor acquisition and brand partnership outreach — identifying prospects, building decks, and closing deals. Maintains a 6+ month operating reserve to cover runway post-launch and a contingency buffer for venue changes, regulatory delays, or scheduling disruptions.
departments.name: Marketing, Working Capital & Reserve

departments.description: Covers the compensation and operating costs of the CEO, COO, and senior executive team. Funds strategic travel for league partnership development, investor relations, and franchise owner meetings. Responsible for board governance, organizational strategy, and cross-departmental alignment. Also covers executive-level legal and advisory fees not captured under Legal & Compliance.
departments.name: Executive

departments.description: Manages the physical infrastructure that keeps FLI Golf running day-to-day. Covers office facilities in San Diego and Scottsdale — rent, utilities, and build-out. Staffs front-office and administrative roles. Owns IT infrastructure: hardware procurement, software licensing, internal tools, and network security. Coordinates event logistics including vendor coordination, equipment shipping, and on-site operations support for tournaments and activations.
departments.name: Operations

departments.description: Drives brand awareness and audience growth across all phases of the league's development. Manages marketing campaigns, public relations, and paid advertising across digital, social, and traditional media. Oversees apparel and merchandise drops — design, production, and fulfillment. Coordinates with the Content & Media department on athlete-driven storytelling and with the Sponsor Outreach team on co-branded activations. Responsible for the FLI Golf brand identity, style guide, and all public-facing creative.
departments.name: Marketing

departments.description: Builds and maintains the digital products that power FLI Golf's fan and operator experience. Owns the FGL mobile app — design, development, and ongoing feature releases. Develops the fantasy and gaming platform, including scoring integrations and real-time data feeds for betting partners. Manages the Pure Mobile production technology stack. Responsible for all software infrastructure: cloud hosting, APIs, data pipelines, and internal tooling used by league staff.
departments.name: Technology

departments.description: Provides ongoing legal counsel across all league operations. Manages contracts for players, franchise owners, sponsors, vendors, and broadcast partners. Handles state-by-state gaming licensing required for the sports betting and fantasy integrations. Oversees trademark filings and IP protection for all FLI Golf marks — league wordmarks, franchise logos, and class registrations. Ensures compliance with SEC regulations, FINRA/SIPC requirements, and applicable sports commission rules in tournament jurisdictions.
departments.name: Legal & Compliance

departments.description: Manages the professional player relationships that define the on-course product. Covers MPO and FPO sponsored player contracts — fees, performance bonuses, and exclusivity terms. Funds player travel support, practice facilities access, and equipment stipends. Produces player-focused content in coordination with the Content & Media team. Responsible for player welfare, dispute resolution, and the development programs that attract top disc golf talent to FLI Golf.
departments.name: Player Development

departments.description: Produces and distributes the content that builds FLI Golf media presence. Owns the documentary and sizzle reel from initial filming through final delivery. Manages the Go Throw Media partnership — quarterly payments and deliverables for professional event coverage. Staffs the broadcasting team for live tournament coverage. Builds and maintains the streaming infrastructure for live and on-demand content delivery. Works closely with the Technology department on encoding, CDN, and platform integrations.
departments.name: Content & Media

departments.description: Handles the financial operations that keep the organization running. Processes payroll for all full-time and part-time staff across departments. Manages employee benefits enrollment, health insurance, and retirement plan administration. Covers relocation assistance for key hires. Maintains general liability, event, and directors & officers insurance policies. Handles accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end financial close in coordination with the CPA.
departments.name: Finance & Administration

departments.description: Manages all tax-exempt reimbursement payments owed to FLI Golf team members for out-of-pocket business expenses. Every claim is reviewed by Ina Masten (CPA, Masten Solutions) to verify proper tax treatment, ensure IRS compliance, and confirm the expense qualifies for tax-exempt status before payment is authorized. Covers travel, meals, supplies, equipment, and other pre-approved expense categories. All reimbursements are processed through the Reimbursements module and tracked against this department for audit purposes.
departments.name: Tax-Exempt Reimbursements

departments.description: Manages all outgoing payments and incoming income for FLI Golf. Outgoing: processes approved expenses, reimbursement work orders, vendor invoices, pro payments, and franchise payouts — all reviewed by Ina Masten (CPA) before payment is issued. Incoming: records and reconciles all revenue received — sponsor payments, franchise fees, merchandise sales, and other income. Every transaction is assigned a reference number that maps directly to the corresponding QuickBooks entry for audit purposes.
departments.name: Payments & Income
